purpose: Teach: 真夜中/どっと/あげく/大金/居間/つぶやい/しつこい/うろうろ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、真夜中にお水飲みたくなったら、ママ呼んでね
lines.en: If you get thirsty in the middle of the night, sweetheart, just call for me.
lines.style: Soft, protective opening. Warm practical tone. The gentle authority of a mother settling her child. Slow, unhurried pace—no rush, I'm here.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祭りでお客様がどっと来たって、お父さんが言ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said a crowd of customers suddenly showed up at the festival.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact reporting. The careful voice of a child relaying something he's noticed matters. No drama, just the facts as he heard them.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、走り回ったあげく、お疲れになったわね
lines.en: You ran yourself ragged out there, didn't you, sweetheart.
lines.style: Knowing, slightly amused warmth. A gentle observation, not a question. Soft recognition of his tiredness mixed with quiet affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが大金を寄付なさったってお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I heard Grandpa made a big donation.
lines.style: Still reporting, but with a hint of wonder underneath. The same careful, perceptive tone. A child processing something significant without quite knowing why it matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、居間でお絵かきしようね
lines.en: Why don't we do some drawing together in the living room.
lines.style: A gentle redirect, warmly offered. Not commanding—inviting. The voice of someone shifting his mood by changing the moment. Calm, easy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが何かつぶやいてたよ
lines.en: Dad was muttering about something earlier.
lines.style: Small, hesitant observation. Not complaining—just noticing and sharing. The voice of a child aware that adults have thoughts he doesn't quite understand.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達が、しつこい誘い方しないか心配
lines.en: I'm a bit worried your friends might not be gentle about how they ask you to do things.
lines.style: Quiet concern beneath a practical surface. A mother thinking aloud, not quite asking. Careful tone—protective but not hovering. The words of someone who knows her son notices things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お家の中をうろうろしてたよ
lines.en: I was just wandering around the house earlier.
lines.style: Small, wry admission. A child explaining his own restlessness with gentle self-awareness. Quiet, slightly apologetic—aware that wandering means something was off.
